verdict.rationale: A government administration portal could plausibly document a sanctioned representative or authorized-provider channel, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only front-door probes: a JavaScript shell and a Cloudflare challenge. It has no mention of designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives acting on a party's behalf.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
